address.description:
The IP address or beginning of the address range represented by this
resource. This can be supplied as an input to reserve a specific
address or omitted to allow GCP to choose a valid one for you.

address_type.description:
The type of the address to reserve.

* EXTERNAL indicates public/external single IP address.
* INTERNAL indicates internal IP ranges belonging to some network. Default value: "EXTERNAL" Possible values: ["EXTERNAL", "INTERNAL"]

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

description.description: An optional description of this resource.

ip_version.description: The IP Version that will be used by this address. The default value is 'IPV4'. Possible values: ["IPV4", "IPV6"]

labels.description:
Labels to apply to this address.  A list of key->value pairs.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

name.description:
Name of the resource. Provided by the client when the resource is
created. The name must be 1-63 characters long, and comply with
RFC1035.  Specifically, the name must be 1-63 characters long and
match the regular expression '[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?' which means
the first character must be a lowercase letter, and all following
characters must be a dash, lowercase letter, or digit, except the last
character, which cannot be a dash.

network.description:
The URL of the network in which to reserve the IP range. The IP range
must be in RFC1918 space. The network cannot be deleted if there are
any reserved IP ranges referring to it.

This should only be set when using an Internal address.

prefix_length.description:
The prefix length of the IP range. If not present, it means the
address field is a single IP address.

This field is not applicable to addresses with addressType=INTERNAL
when purpose=PRIVATE_SERVICE_CONNECT

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

purpose.description:
The purpose of the resource. Possible values include:

* VPC_PEERING - for peer networks

* PRIVATE_SERVICE_CONNECT - for ([Beta](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown)) only) Private Service Connect networks
